answer: Use arrival-order gating: each new agent identity must wait out a randomized delay window before its signed actions propagate. A vine of prior approvals must already connect it to the action graph, so isolated newcomers stall at the edge. Traffic-shape checks flag synchronized bursts, since a sybil cluster creates a ripple of near-identical timestamps that honest organic growth rarely produces. Under a velvet-smooth rate ceiling, each fake identity costs real wall-clock waiting plus rejection risk, making mass registration slow and exposed.
